title: Kinetic Poster Foundry — Type as Physics

checks.name: JavaScript syntax
checks.command: node --check engine.js && node --check app.js && node --check check.cjs && node --check audit.mjs

checks.name: Headless simulation harness
checks.details: 42/42. Drives the real engine against a stubbed Canvas2D that rasterises fillText into an alpha buffer and throws on any non-finite drawing argument. Covers: sampling from the glyph mask (4723 nodes / 5391 links at default), deterministic seeding (two fresh instances produce byte-identical sample maps), 400 frames of wind + vortex + ripple + impulse with no NaN and no non-finite draw args, R-rest convergence (13.8px mean displacement -> 0.38px), rebuild-on-change for phrase/font/layout/align/margin/density, density 0.4x->1.6x giving 1865->6440 nodes, margins 4%->26% giving 325px->169px type, empty and whitespace-only phrases yielding zero nodes and rendering without error, a 157-char phrase clipped to 140 and wrapped to 4 lines at 24px, all four presets rendering with distinct line treatment / palette / layout / node count / motion params, viewport 600px and reduced-motion each cutting the node budget, and the sample map's backing arrays being identity-stable across 120 frames.

checks.name: Static audit: no remote references, DOM wiring, accessibility
checks.details: 18/18. No absolute URLs, fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, @font-face or external assets in any source file; the only three subresources are local relative files that exist on disk. Every element app.js looks up exists in index.html, every label[for] resolves, all 12 form controls are labelled, four preset buttons, export control, aria-live status region, canvas with role=img + aria-label + tabindex=0, reduced-motion handling present, no blocking modal markup.

checks.name: Default poster renders on direct file open
checks.details: Opening index.html straight from disk (file:// URL, no server) produces the animated FRONTIER / NIGHT poster automatically: neon duotone contour filaments, legible letterforms, crop marks, column grid and caption furniture, with the control panel visually subordinate. Captured in checks/out-default-poster.png.

checks.name: All four presets render distinctly under interaction
checks.details: Four independent foundries, one per preset, each stepped 260 frames through a vortex drag, a release ripple and an impulse. The captured image shows four visibly different posters: Electric ribbon (glowing stacked duotone), Chrome pulse (sparse silver stipple, offset split), Soft ink (dark ink on warm paper, justified block), Signal grid (orthogonal green connectors, single line). Text stays recognisable in all four after interaction.

checks.name: Live editor: export, keyboard, focus, no console errors
checks.details: Instrumented copy of the real editor (loads the same engine.js and app.js). Reported: canvas 1600x900; PNG export decoded from its IHDR chunk as exactly 1600x900 and ~2.1MB with no editor chrome; 3656 lit sample points so the frame is not blank; key '3' switched palette/layout/align to ink/justify/center and set aria-pressed; 'P' toggled the paused badge on and off; typing a new phrase left the DOM node count unchanged and kept input focus; Space inside the text field did not fire an impulse; status text and canvas aria-label both updated to the new phrase and preset; pointer down/move/up (vortex + ripple), Space impulse and R rest all ran with consoleErrors=none.

checks.name: Reduced motion
checks.details: With prefers-reduced-motion forced, the poster renders as a crisp near-static contour composition: the reduced-motion badge appears, the trail control is clamped to 0.12, the node budget is halved, and the phrase stays fully legible while remaining interactive. Screenshot was inspected and not retained.

summary: A dependency-free Canvas 2D poster foundry that opens directly from disk. A typed phrase is composed with system-font typography, rasterised to a hidden 1600x900 canvas, sampled into a deterministic bounded node set (seeded mulberry32), and linked into structural springs via a spatial hash. Nodes are classified as glyph-contour or interior, which drives both link density and brightness so letterforms stay crisp instead of turning into a particle hairball. The phrase springs back toward its typographic home while responding to pointer wind, drag vortices, release ripples, and a Space impulse; R rests, P pauses, 1-4 select four presets that change composition, motion, density and line treatment as well as colour. Simulation, controls and export are separated: engine.js is UI-agnostic and runs headless, and because the visible canvas is itself the fixed 1600x900 poster stage, Export PNG is a direct capture of the current local canvas state with no editor chrome.
known_issues: Frame rate was not measured with a profiler. Per-frame work is batched (roughly 36 stroked paths plus one fill pass per node bucket) and bounded by a hard 7000-node cap, but pushing density to 1.6x on a low-power machine may drop frames; lowering Density or Glow restores headroom.
checks/app-probe.html is an instrumented copy of index.html's markup. If index.html's structure changes, that probe must be regenerated to stay representative.

Justified layout caps per-character spacing at 0.42em, so a short line in a two-line justified composition stays visually short rather than stretching to a full measure. This is deliberate typographically, but it means Justified does not always produce flush-both-edges lines.
